note: GDD 1.3 section 10 suggested test presets. Not gameplay modes. Each preset changes these features over the manifest defaults; everything else keeps its manifest default. All APPROVED_P0 features are on by default (GDD 1.3 section 5 manifest invariants), so BASE changes nothing. Numbers come from GDD 1.3 section 5A; a preset never changes BASE defaults. The workbench that loads them exists only in debug and dev builds (D-new-workbench-debug); the approved preset ships as plain defaults through tools/bake_preset.py.

presets.name: BASE
presets.learning_goal: Does the complete 90-second encounter work and remain readable?
presets.note: All APPROVED_P0 features on: movement, auto attack, front shield/heal, one owl bolt, safe wind, sprite animations, parallax, clock/body hitboxes, screens. Experimental modules off. Loads every section 5A value.

presets.name: MOTOR
presets.learning_goal: Do gravity, ascent, steering and state priority work?
presets.note: Base movement only: owl attacks, shield healing and wind off for this test only.

presets.name: SHIELD
presets.learning_goal: Do blocks register once, avoid damage, and only heal when allowed?
presets.note: Frontal shield + one bolt; log catches during the heal cooldown separately. Side catching (UMB-03) stays off.

presets.name: RECOVER
presets.learning_goal: Can a damaged player recover without creating an infinite-health loop?
presets.note: Baseline plus a low-health starting scenario and the shield cooldown values.

presets.name: WIND
presets.learning_goal: Is wind readable; are danger and advantage distinguishable?
presets.note: Safe environmental wind (WIND-01) on, as in BASE. Wind wear (WIND-02) only as a separate isolated EXPERIMENT run with its own ticket.

presets.name: CLOCK
presets.learning_goal: Does CLOCK precedence work, and can effects be attached later?
presets.note: Required clock/body hit routing (OWL-05) on, as in BASE. Clock interrupt (COM-02) off until approved.

presets.name: VISUAL
presets.learning_goal: Are frames anchored and threats legible at gameplay size?
presets.note: P0 sprite loops (ANIM-01) and sliding background (BG-01) on; compare with a static background and minimal frames. ART-02 stays off.
